detailed_description:
Anime style.
[Shot 1] Tight side-on medium shot at chest height inside <Subject 3>, warm chandelier light raking across cream marble columns and gold-framed mirrors. <Subject 1> in her fitted wine-red satin gown, chestnut waves swinging, has already thrown her arm forward in a full slap; <Subject 2> in her plain charcoal-grey high-collar work dress, long black hair with a thin silver hairpin, snaps her hand up and catches the wrist in mid-air a few centimetres from her cheek. The gold bracelet jolts against caught skin. Guests behind them freeze with glasses half-raised. Camera holds static, then drifts a few centimetres closer as <Subject 1> leans in, teeth showing, and pushes against the grip without moving it. <Subject 1> (S1) says in a bright brittle voice, thrown loud enough for the tables around them, <d>[Russian] Ты лезла к моему жениху.</d> Physical sound: the flat clap of palm meeting palm, satin creaking, a fork set down on porcelain.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, reverse over-the-shoulder close-up favouring <Subject 2>, the red gown burning out of focus on the left edge of frame. Her face is calm, jaw set, a single strand of black hair fallen loose across her temple; her fingers stay locked around the other woman's wrist, knuckles pale from the effort, forearm steady from months of carrying a heavy child. Chandelier reflections crawl in her dark eyes. She does not raise her volume. Camera performs a very slow push-in on her eyes, the crowd blurring to gold behind her. <Subject 2> (S2) says in a quiet level voice, almost gentle, <d>[Russian] Докажите. Хоть чем-нибудь.</d> Behind her the murmur swells and someone whispers into a phone; her grip tightens once at the end of the line and <Subject 1> flinches out of frame. Physical sound: a bracelet ticking against bone, a phone camera shutter, the string quartet thinning out as players notice the fight.
